transcript.text: Before we get further into this consultation, I want to put an access consideration on the table that hasn't been reflected in the merger proposal. I've observed that several prospective participants need recordings and asynchronous access to meeting content, and I personally cannot reliably attend meetings beginning after 3:00 p.m. These access needs haven't been raised in the proposal because the groups have historically scheduled their own meetings independently. If we're moving to a combined monthly meeting under a shared charter, I think it's critical that these needs are addressed in the operating conditions — things like guaranteed recording availability, asynchronous participation options, and scheduling that doesn't exclude members with time-of-day constraints.
